title: Cajetan/Bellarmino: vows to Saints as ‘gods by participation’—vows made to God in the Saints
source_text: XXX. Itaque aliud respondet, cum Cajetano, Bellarminus, nempe vota fieri Sanctis, non ut sunt creaturae quaedam rationis participes, sed quatenus sunt Dii per participationem, & ut in iis Deus habitat per gloriam, ita ut vota, quae fieri dicuntur Sanctis, fiant Deo in Sanctis: quomodo maledicta in Sanctos dicuntur blasphemia, quia Deus in Sanctis maledicitur.
pass_a_gloss: And so Bellarmine, with Cajetan, answers otherwise, namely that vows are made to the Saints not as they are certain creatures partaking of reason, but insofar as they are Gods by participation, and as God dwells in them by glory, so that vows which are said to be made to the Saints are made to God in the Saints: just as curses against the Saints are called blasphemy, because God is cursed in the Saints.
pass_b_english: Backup line (Cajetan via Bellarmino): vow to Saints as gods-by-participation where God dwells in glory.
Thus the vow is to God in the Saints—as cursing Saints blasphemes God in them.

choices.why: Mode of divine inhabitation grounding the vow.
